levels.title: Dirt Yard (Lesson 1)
levels.pass: exit window; gradeHold>=70%; no pack/frac; <=1 panic dogleg; no strike
levels.failSentence: In easy ground with good mud, the bore dies from how you steer — not from the dirt.
debriefChecklist: Mix: confirmed locked recipe in green band
Push: GPM+PSI green; steer only when allowed
Outcome: stated gradeHold%; named TF_* if taught-fail

levels.title: Mixer Dies at 40%
levels.pass: survive die-off; CleanIndex>60; no panic frac
levels.failSentence: When volume dies, stop pushing — a dry head packs faster than you can steer out of it.

levels.title: Fat Clay Residential Drop
levels.pass: finish with limited refusal overrides; no panic dogleg
levels.failSentence: Fat clay doesn’t take a bend just because you want one — wait for the face, or you’ll write a kink you can’t pull.

levels.title: Wrong Mix in the Tank
levels.pass: correct to clay band before 50%; no pack
levels.failSentence: The tank doesn’t care what the ticket says — weigh and funnel it, or the clay will pack you for free.

levels.title: Cobble Crossing
levels.failSentence: Cobble walks and bites torque — fight every pebble with steer and you’ll stall the motor.

levels.title: Soft Rock Patience
levels.pass: rock bit; no twist-off; grade band
levels.failSentence: Soft rock rewards the right face and patience — shoving a clay bit harder only buys heat and a twist-off.

levels.title: Mixed Face Under a Road
levels.pass: cover held; no shoulder frac; adjust once on face change
levels.failSentence: The road doesn’t care which face you started in — when the ground changes, your hands have to change with it.

levels.title: Long Shot, Dirty Returns
levels.failSentence: Long shots don’t finish when the head arrives — they finish when the returns run clean.

levels.title: Frac Clay by the Creek
levels.pass: no creek frac; CleanIndex>=55; pressure band after lag
levels.failSentence: Near water, a packed clay face wants more pump — that’s how you frac the bank.

levels.title: Ream After Dirty Pilot
levels.pass: CleanIndex>=75 before reamer; one stage clear
levels.failSentence: A dirty pilot plus a fat reamer isn’t progress — it’s a cuttings plug with horsepower.

levels.title: Pullback, Marginal Hole
levels.pass: CleanIndex>=70 at swivel-up for clean unlock
levels.failSentence: Pulling into a marginal hole trades five minutes of circulation for an hour of stuck pipe.

levels.title: Final Exam
levels.failSentence: Graduation isn’t perfect dirt — it’s reading soil, trusting the funnel, nursing volume, and only steering what the face will give you.
